answer: Use a small, refundable work bond and random independent counterparties: an agent earns reputation only after those partners verify a completed task, while proven collusion forfeits the bond. An atlas of past links can seed fresh pairings; a jetty-like cooldown slows rapid account cycling, and a lantern-style public log lets auditors spot clusters. This makes Sybil farming costly, but wealthy cartels or biased reviewers remain possible, so cap each cluster's influence and allow appeals.
